Definition: properly, to plait or interpenetrate, i.e. (literally) to weave or (generally) to fabricate; figuratively, to plot or contrive (usually in a malicious sense); hence (from the mental effort) to think, regard, value, compute
BiblicalUsage: 1) to think, plan, esteem, calculate, invent, make a judgment, imagine, count; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to think, account; 1a2) to plan, devise, mean; 1a3) to charge, impute, reckon; 1a4) to esteem, value, regard; 1a5) to invent; 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to be accounted, be thought, be esteemed; 1b2) to be computed, be reckoned; 1b3) to be imputed; 1c) (Piel); 1c1) to think upon, consider, be mindful of; 1c2) to think to do, devise, plan; 1c3) to count, reckon; 1d) (Hithpael) to be considered
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
